items.title: Continuously hardening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection attacks using automated red teaming trained with reinforcement learning. This proactive discover-and-patch loop helps identify novel exploits early and harden the browser agent’s defenses as AI becomes more agentic.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正在通过自动化红队测试（Automated Red Teaming）强化ChatGPT Atlas的安全性，重点防御提示词注入攻击。该机制通过强化学习构建“发现-修复”循环，旨在随着AI代理化程度的加深，主动识别并修补潜在漏洞，从而提升系统的整体防御韧性。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI通过自动化红队测试强化ChatGPT Atlas的防御能力，是代理系统安全领域的重要实践。

items.title: One in a million: celebrating the customers shaping AI’s future
items.summary: More than one million customers around the world now use OpenAI to empower their teams and unlock new opportunities. This post highlights how companies like PayPal, Virgin Atlantic, BBVA, Cisco, Moderna, and Canva are transforming the way work gets done with AI.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布博文庆祝其客户群规模达到百万级，并列举了多家企业利用AI进行业务转型的案例。该内容主要侧重于商业推广与客户关系维护，未涉及具体模型技术细节或行业技术突破。
